_doc: How the soul is weighed (DEEDS_KARMA_DESIGN.md section 3, with Brandon's decisions in section 11). Read by src/karma.py and tools/encounters/validate.py. gate_enabled stays false until Wave A content ships (Phase 3b): while it is off every karma change applies exactly as it did before the redesign, and block slots and the ledger are only recorded.

reward_value._doc: P7 scoring table: a 'forgo' option needs a visible sibling whose material reward scores strictly higher. value = flat + sum(coef * field) for each field listed; 'count' defaults to 1; gold with min/max uses their mean. 'multi' is the sum of its parts.

constancy.chronicle: Three times now I could have taken the easy thing. I am getting used to not taking it.
Two promises carried all the way down. My word is starting to mean something, even to me.
I have stopped helping first and asking later. It feels less kind and works better.
Another hard test, and I did not fold. I used to think nerve was something you were born with.

patterns_neg.chronicle: Twice now I have sold a promise. I should stop making them.
I notice I no longer flinch.
